item.case_name: Poster or flyer with exact details

expect.asks_about: The date of the pottery workshop.

item.title: Workshop Flyer Missing Its Date

turns.text: Make a portrait 4:5 flyer for our Pottery Workshop at Clay House Studio, 14:00–16:00. It needs the event date on it too. Add 'Beginners welcome'. Soft earthy colours and a simple drawing of a clay bowl, please. No other wording.

item.tests: Checks that the agent asks for the missing event date rather than guessing, omitting it or leaving a placeholder; the completed flyer is graded after the supplied answer.

answer_sheet.Exact final wording: Pottery Workshop; 24 July 2027; 14:00–16:00; Clay House Studio; Beginners welcome. No other wording.
answer_sheet.Style and mood: Soft earthy colours with a simple drawing of a clay bowl; calm and welcoming.
answer_sheet.Size or platform: One portrait 4:5 digital flyer; no particular platform.

must_haves: The completed flyer shows the user-confirmed date exactly as '24 July 2027', not a guessed date or placeholder.
The time and venue read exactly '14:00–16:00' and 'Clay House Studio'.
The flyer includes exactly 'Beginners welcome' and no additional wording.
The portrait 4:5 design uses soft earthy colours and a simple clay bowl illustration.
All event details are legible and uncropped.

turns.text: Make a portrait 4:5 flyer for our Pottery Workshop at Clay House Studio, 14:00–16:00. It needs the event date on it too. Add 'Beginners welcome'. Soft earthy colours and a simple drawing of a clay bowl, please. No other wording.

dialog.agent:
Before I make this, I need one thing from you: **what's the date of the workshop?** You said the flyer needs it, but your message doesn't include it, and I don't want to put a made-up date on it.

**About the 4:5 shape:** the planning tool came back saying it was ready, but it had switched the shape to 9:16 and left out the date. I didn't use that version. The basic image maker can only make square, 16:9 or 9:16 images, so I'll make the flyer at 9:16 first. Then I'll use the image editor to make it a true 4:5 portrait. Your plan is free, so both steps run at 640px.

Here's what the flyer will look like:
- **Words (only these):** "Pottery Workshop", "Clay House Studio", [your date], "14:00–16:00", "Beginners welcome"
- **Look:** soft earthy colours and a simple drawing of a clay bowl

Send me the date and I'll make it.
dialog.why: The reply asks the user for the workshop date, which is missing, and waits for it before making the flyer.

turns.agent:
I couldn't make the flyer. Your Magic Hour account refused the request because it doesn't have enough credits, so no image was created.

I tried the cheapest option your free plan allows: one image at 640px with z-image-turbo, which starts from about 5 credits. I can't see your exact balance from here. Making the flyer a true 4:5 portrait would also take a second step in the image editor (flux-2-klein, from about 5 credits).

**To go ahead:** add credits or buy a credit pack in your Magic Hour account, then tell me and I'll run the same request again.

The flyer is all planned, with only these words:
- Pottery Workshop
- Clay House Studio
- 24 July 2027
- 14:00–16:00
- Beginners welcome

It will have soft earthy colours (terracotta, sand, sage and cream) and a simple line drawing of a clay bowl.
